<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Allow serialized compressed-tensors W8A8 FP8 tensor/channel checkpoints to reuse Marlin-packed weights through the weight cache daemon. Follow-up to #63673 for #56049; the [five-file incremental diff](https://github.com/liusy58/vllm/compare/4d954d5d1289d3940116fdafca757a12aa363873...8aa5f2005b3f006d6a0b6f3164de48cca691c2aa) isolates this feature.

## Claims

- Preserve packed weights, reordered scales and padded/permuted bias across repeated IPC attachments without rerunning Marlin post-processing.
- Support tensor/channel FP8 weights with FP16/BF16 activations. Block FP8, MoE and other compressed-tensors schemes remain excluded.
- Preserve the CUTLASS path and existing model-output assertions. The FP8 format guide links directly to Marlin setup and limitations.

## Validation

Validated the revised source on B300, with all five changed-file hashes matching the tested files:

| Current revised source | Result |
| --- | --- |
| CUTLASS/Marlin real layer, repeated shared attachment, attention-scale and block rejection cases | 27 passed, 53.56s |
| Pinned Llama3.1 8B FP8, CUTLASS and Marlin: ordinary → fallback → IPC → second IPC | 2 passed, 227.11s |
| Changed-file pre-commit, including mypy, ruff, docs and CI tethering | Passed |

Both IPC loads forbid fallback. Layer assertions require exact output equality and unchanged shared storage/content. CUTLASS keeps exact model-output assertions with batch invariance; Marlin uses existing `check_logprobs_close` defaults with prompt/sample top-5 logprobs, two prompts and 16 generated tokens because Marlin is not batch invariant. No new retries, skips, xfails or relaxed tolerances.

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/quantization/test_compressed_tensors.py \
  -k compressed_fp8_preprocessed -q -rs

.venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  tests/model_executor/model_loader/test_weight_cache.py::test_ipc_cache_compressed_fp8 \
  tests/model_executor/model_loader/test_weight_cache.py::test_ipc_cache_compressed_fp8_marlin \
  -q -rs
```

Runtime: isolated Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.14/cu130, FlashInfer 0.7.2.post1, task-local CUDAcompat13.4, and reused stable native extensions from `5d55ef159`. This is local feature validation, not a pristine source rebuild, full dependency matrix, hosted GPU CI result, model-quality evaluation or performance claim. Other users' processes and the shared checkout/environment were untouched. An initial GPU7 occupancy check stopped before launching tests; the recorded tests ran on idle GPU5.

<details>
<summary>Checkpoint wrapper and historical baseline</summary>

The local validation plugin replaces only the two test-case model locations with the already-cached RedHatAI/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-FP8 snapshot `881d74b74ad8ebe8775fb178b1fd0c935477f1bc` and sets the CUTLASS memory budget to the same `0.12` already used by the Marlin case:

```python
from dataclasses import replace
from tests.model_executor.model_loader import test_weight_cache as suite

def pytest_configure(config):
    for name in ("COMPRESSED_FP8_CASE", "COMPRESSED_FP8_MARLIN_CASE"):
        case = getattr(suite, name)
        setattr(suite, name, replace(
            case, model="/home/liusy/codex-runtime/checkpoints/compressed-881d74b74a",
            llm_kwargs={**case.llm_kwargs, "gpu_memory_utilization": 0.12}))
```

The recorded model command adds `-p _codex_nov04_validation` to the pytest invocation above. No model execution method or assertion is patched.

Historical October 30 baseline evidence on parent `03b39f9a8f87`, with the same new tests: the real Marlin layer failed with `CompressedTensorsLinearMethod does not support pre-processed weights`; ordinary/fallback model generation succeeded but the daemon failed with `UnsupportedQuantForIPCError`. Those original logs remain evidence for the feature, not reruns of the revised parent.

</details>

The B200 quantized-preload job's `compressed_fp8` and `compressed_fp8_preprocessed` selectors cover the model and layer cases; its dependencies cover the changed source. Local documentation discovery passed on the revised files. Fresh independent GitHub-source verification also passed on immutable head `8aa5f2005b3f006d6a0b6f3164de48cca691c2aa`, including enablement, defaults, scope/exclusions and discovery links. The rendered-preview check stopped when automatic approval to read its build metadata timed out; it has not established that the visible preview matches this head. The hosted docs check reports success, but this does not replace current-head content/discovery verification. Historical preview results are not counted as current.

## Details

Marlin's constructor creates the runtime state, while its post-load hook repacks weights and transforms scales/bias. The existing processed-weight early return can therefore reuse the daemon tensors. The capability opt-in checks the actual Marlin kernel and rejects block strategy; no kernel or common loader interface changes.

This revision replays only the Marlin increment onto the current #63673 head `4d954d5d1289d3940116fdafca757a12aa363873`, removing conflicts inherited from the old stack and retaining maintainer changes already merged to main. It still depends on #63673; the incremental diff above excludes that prerequisite. It merges cleanly with main `625d2d74e` in the local merge-tree check.

Duplicate checks covered #56049, compressed-tensors IPC and Marlin FP8. #63673 supplies the prerequisite; #64182 covers AWQ/GPTQ; #42657 concerns ordinary W8A16 processing. None duplicates this W8A8 Marlin IPC feature.

AI assistance was used. This remains a draft for human review and validation; no completed human review or human-run testing is asserted.

+## Compressed-tensors FP8 with Marlin
+
+On CUDA GPUs with compute capability 8.9 or newer, serialized
+`compressed-tensors` W8A8 FP8 checkpoints can reuse their Marlin weights
+through the weight cache daemon. This supports dense linear layers with
+per-tensor or per-channel weight scales and static per-tensor or dynamic
+per-token checkpoint activation schemes. Marlin computes with FP8 weights
+and FP16 or BF16 activations; the checkpoint's activation quantization is
+not used by this weight-only backend.
+
+Select Marlin explicitly and use the same dtype in both processes:
+
+```bash
+vllm preload --model RedHatAI/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-FP8 \
+    --dtype bfloat16 --kernel-config '{"linear_backend": "marlin"}'
+
+vllm serve RedHatAI/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-FP8 \
+    --dtype bfloat16 --kernel-config '{"linear_backend": "marlin"}' \
+    --load-format ipc_cache
+```
+
+The daemon packs the weights and reorders the scales once. Each engine
+reuses those tensors without repacking them, including on repeated restarts.
+The default `zero_copy` mode and disk fallback behavior are unchanged; see
+[Loader configuration](#loader-configuration). Marlin does not support
+`VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1`. This support does not include block FP8, MoE,
+or other compressed-tensors quantization schemes.
+
